description: This file defines the class FormatWithSkill, which implements the ValueFormatter interface to provide a method for formatting entity values into skill names using a SkillService. It includes methods for retrieving a skill by ID and returning its name, or null if not found.

classes.name: FormatWithSkill
classes.description: A class implementing ValueFormatter to format skill IDs into skill names by leveraging SkillService.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Fetches the Skill entity by ID and returns its name or null if not found.

methods.name: getSkillService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of SkillService.
